confidence_notes: I did two web searches: one for the RBA exchange rate and one for Takayama food and drink prices. The FX figure is AUD/USD 0.6720, which the search summary attributed to the RBA's own published rate for 2026-11-18. Other market reports from the same week gave about the same rate. The price search found little Takayama-specific data. A Hostelworld Takayama guide puts meals at about EUR 6-20 and a beer at about EUR 4-6. Nationwide Numbeo averages for Japan are roughly JPY 1,000 for an inexpensive meal, JPY 500 for a cappuccino and JPY 500 for a domestic draft beer. Other sources describe Takayama as moderately priced and cheaper than Tokyo or Kyoto, but it is a busy tourist town. I adjusted the national averages slightly upward for tourist-area pricing and for the July 2026 peak season. I converted yen at an assumed rate of about JPY 150 per USD, which was not checked in a search. I had no direct data for cocktails or wine, so I based them on their usual price relationship to beer in Japan. All accommodation figures are my own estimates from general knowledge, not checked against any booking site or listing. July is a busy summer season in Takayama, so actual room prices could be noticeably higher.
comparable_city_reasoning: I started from Japan's national average prices and adjusted them for a small but very touristy heritage town. The closest comparisons are Kanazawa and Nikko, and Takayama should be cheaper than Kyoto or Tokyo, especially for dining and hotels.
